behavior.sharedReadiness: Coalesce in-flight readiness only within the same company, environment, computer, provider, controller and secret reference/version.
behavior.callerDeadlines: Each caller retains its own deadline; expiration does not cancel another waiter. Requests are fenced again after asynchronous secret resolution.
behavior.lifecycle: Completed and failed entries evict. Every inspection preserves physical identity, snapshots and stop-state guards. No ownership authority change.
behavior.diagnostics: Closed operation labels accompany HTTP status; no response body, URL, credentials or raw provider error included.

preFixConcurrencyRegression.finding: Concurrent archived readiness independently dispatches resume and rejects one caller.

preFenceSecretResolutionRegression.finding: A sole expired waiter still dispatched resume after held secret resolution; dispatch-time check now prevents it.

limitations: The historical staging25 c990ff5f HTTP409 endpoint and response semantics remain unproven. The source concurrency defect is independently reproduced.
